remarks: Beautifully updated end-unit townhouse in a prime Norwalk location. Bathed in natural light, this beautifully renovated home showcases soaring ceilings, a bright and airy interior, and tasteful updates throughout, including a brand new kitchen, updated bathroom vanities, and fresh paint. The desirable end-unit position enhances both privacy and sunlight, while the thoughtfully refreshed interior offers a clean, modern aesthetic and move-in-ready ease. Conveniently located near downtown Norwalk, vibrant dining and shopping, local amenities, and commuter trains, this residence offers a refined blend of comfort, style, and accessibility.
